accepted.why: TPS2552 OUT (abs max 7 V, SLVS841G 6.1) on SVC_VBUS, whose 10.3 V transient is D25 (SMF6.0A) at its full 19.4 A 10/1000 us surge rating -- not a credible event on an internal service USB-C port. ESD on OUT is covered by SLVS841G 6.2 (IEC 61000-4-2 +-8 kV contact / +-15 kV air, output terminals, with external capacitance). No hardware fix exists: no TVS clamps under 7 V at that current, and a series R does not fit a 1.2 A path. Steady is 5.5 V. Supersedes the 2026-11-17 review note.
